salt_name.description: Name of the salt used in the experiment

process_id.description: Process identifier configured in the automation system

pump_speed.description: Pump speed setting (unit as configured on instrument)

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of resin loaded per well

ligand_name.description: Name of the ligand (solute) loaded onto the resin

total_volume_uL.description: Total volume of ligand solution used per well

venting_time.description: Venting time for the pumping step (string to preserve units)

pump_duration.description: Duration of pump operation (string to preserve units)

incubation_time.description: Total incubation time before measurement (string to preserve units)

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used across columns

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles (kept as string due to possible annotations)

ligand_concentrations.description: List of initial ligand concentrations used for each row

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Measurement wavelength configured on the plate reader

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit for ligand concentrations (e.g., mM, µM)

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration

equilibration_cycle_duration.description: Duration of a single equilibration cycle (raw string)

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations defined in the metadata

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations defined in the metadata

timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database

analysis_results.description: Raw analysis_results dictionary produced by the Tecan loading isotherm analysis script

summary.description: Key derived metrics across all salt conditions

num_salt_conditions.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations with fits

num_ligand_conditions.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations per salt condition (where available)

num_fit_success.description: Number of salt conditions where Langmuir fitting returned finite parameters

num_fit_failed.description: Number of salt conditions where Langmuir fitting failed or returned invalid parameters

q_max_mean.description: Mean q_max across all successful Langmuir fits

q_max_std.description: Standard deviation of q_max across successful fits

K_mean.description: Mean binding constant K across all successful Langmuir fits

K_std.description: Standard deviation of binding constant K across successful fits

r2_mean.description: Mean coefficient of determination R^2 across successful fits

r2_std.description: Standard deviation of R^2 across successful fits

data_files.description: Structured links to key output data files

analysis_results_json.description: Path to the main analysis_results_*.json file

tecan_raw_file.description: Path to the downloaded or discovered raw Tecan Excel file

per_well_csv.description: Path to per-well processed CSV file

aggregated_csv.description: Path to aggregated per-condition CSV file

isotherms_png.description: PNG plot of loading isotherms with Langmuir fits

isotherms_pdf.description: PDF plot of loading isotherms with Langmuir fits
